title: fix: include all linked PRs for multi-winner quests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reads up to 100 linked PRs instead of 10 so pending submissions do not hide merged winners.
- Keeps the existing per-author reward and deduplication logic unchanged.
- Verified the live GitHub query includes all five selected authors among 26 submissions.
- Addresses #15054; does not close it.

gist.headline: No winner lost in the weeds
gist.blurb: Multi-winner Quests now look past the first ten submissions before handing out Pollen. The garden ledger can see all the selected bees again.
gist.summary: Quest GitHub contribution checks now read up to 100 linked pull requests instead of 10, ensuring merged winners remain visible among larger submission pools while preserving per-author rewards and deduplication.
gist.impact: Contributors to multi-winner Quests can reliably have their selected merged PR recognized even when the Quest has dozens of pending submissions.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy Quest garden with a long row of 26 pull-request seed packets, where Polli uses a tiny librarian visor and magnifying glass to find five gold winner flowers hidden beyond the first ten. A CRT monitor robot holds the expanded GitHub-style ledger, while glowing Pollen tokens gather beside each selected flower to represent correct reward recognition.
